lines.text: Stop saying close with the school!
Many learners say: My house is close with the school.
Better: My house is close to the school.
Use close to for a place that is near.
To! My house is close to the school.

data.wrong: My house is close with the school.
data.right: My house is close to the school.
data.why: Use close to for a place that is near.
